data.gender_notes: Nuwwar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nawwar', which means 'to light up', 'to illuminate'. Nuwwar is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing radiance, light, and illumination. The name Nuwwar carries the meaning “Light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuwwar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
